newsitems.author: denghaoyuan
newsitems.contents: [h1]\[Update Contents][/h1][h3][b]- New Doll -[/b][/h3][p]■ Elite Doll \[Basti][/p][p][/p][h3][b]- New Weapons -[/b][/h3][p]■ Elite Weapon \[Dona Eis Requiem][/p][p]■ Standard Weapon \[.45 ACP Pistol][/p][p]■ Retired Weapon \[Retired .45 ACP Pistol][/p][p][/p][h3][b]- New Outfit -[/b][/h3][p]■ Outfit \[Basti - Peach Soda] and its swappable purple-quality accessories[/p][p][/p][h3][b]- New Contents -[/b][/h3][p]■ Time-Limited Event Story \[Needy Catgirl Overload]. [/p][p]・ During the event, new event stages and event modes \[Daily Message] and \[Memory Puzzle] will be gradually opened. \[Heroic Mode] will be available for some stages. Commanders can receive generous rewards including \[Collapse Pieces], \[Targeted Access Permissions], and \[Access Permissions] by clearing event stages and participating in the event Game mode.[/p][p]* Available from June 4, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Rate Up Event \[Targeted Procurement] and \[Military Upgrade].[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Basti] and Elite Weapon \[Dona Eis Requiem] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Voymastina] and Elite Weapon \[6P71] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Lind] and Elite Weapon \[Thorn Criterion] will be increased.[/p][p]■ Covenant and Archive unlocked for \[Basti]. [/p][p]■ Neural Helix System Expansion: \[Peritya].[/p][p]■ Added a new Doll \[Basti] to the \[Holography] in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Added a new Doll \[Basti] to the \[Welcome Ceremony] in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ New \[Voyage Logs] are available from June 4, 9:00 (UTC-4). Added rewards \[Namecard Background - Street Art] and \[Portrait Frame - Wintry Camellia] for \[Broker's Path].[/p][p]■ Added \[Neural Migration - Silvered Whispers] in \[Past Events].[/p][p]■ Added Weapon Skins from Past Event in \[Shop] - \[Trading Post] - \[Neural Integration].[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Event \[Broker's Rebate]. During the event, participate in Limited Procurements a certain number of times to receive additional rewards such as \[Surprise Access Permissions] and \[Universal Chain Keys].[/p][p]*\[Surprise Access Permission] can be used for all Limited-Time Procurements from 09:00 on June 25, 2026 to 18:59 on August 5, 2026 (UTC-4), including \[Targeted Procurement], \[Military Upgrade] and \[Custom Procurement]. It cannot be used before the effective period or outside the designated Procurement periods. It will become invalid after the expiration date.[/p][p]* Available from June 4, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Added Time-Limited Packages \[Vivacious Gift Box - Peach Soda] and \[Vivacious Outfit Box - Assorted Flavors] in \[Shop] - \[Quality Selection] - \[Time-Limited Package].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]- Optimizations & Bug Fixes -[/b][/h3][p]■ Fixed an issue where "Random" function was abnormal when inviting a Doll in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Delicious Cuisine] gameplay under specific circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where an abnormal issue would occur when editing Wall Decorations on the Display Wall in the \[Crew Deck] under specific circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the "Leisure Chat" of Voymastina's Outfit - \[B-ROBO Voymawari] could not be triggered in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Fixed certain issues with the texts.[/p][p][/p][p]Notes:[/p][p]The game will be inaccessible during maintenance. Please plan your time in advance.[/p][p]If you are in a mission when maintenance begins, your progress will not be saved. Please complete your ongoing missions before the maintenance to avoid losing progress.[/p][p]The exact end time of maintenance may be delayed or earlier. Please look to our website or social media accounts for updates in case of any delays.[/p][p]Please claim your maintenance compensation from the mailbox promptly after maintenance ends. Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p][/p][p]GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM Operations Team[/p]

newsitems.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Update Contents 4/22

newsitems.contents: [p][b]- New Doll -[/b][/p][p]■ Elite Doll \[Helen][/p][p][/p][p][b]- New Weapons -[/b][/p][p]■ Elite Weapon \[Dulcet Defender][/p][p]■ Standard Weapon \[SG-12][/p][p]■ Retired Weapon \[Retired SG-12][/p][p][/p][p][b]- New Outfits & Skins -[/b][/p][p]■ Outfit \[Helen - Starlit Waltz][/p][p]■ Outfit \[Leva - Sultry Tempo] and its swappable orange-quality accessories[/p][p]* After obtaining Leva's \[Outfit - Sultry Tempo], Commander can invite Leva to the \[Crew Deck - Fitness Center - Rowbike] and trigger her immersive story scene[/p][p]■ Outfit \[Dushevnaya - Tomorrow's Savior] and its swappable purple-quality accessories[/p][p]* Dushevnaya's \[Outfit -Tomorrow's Savior] and its swappable accessories will be available to purchase simultaneously in the \[Outfit Bouquet] and Outfit Procurement - \[Sultry Tempo][/p][p]■ Themed Skin Set \[Brilliant Banquet][/p][p][/p][p][b]- New Contents -[/b][/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event Story \[Antiparallel - Part 1]. [/p][p]・ During the event, new event stories, stages, new gameplay \[Soirée - Starlight Gala] and game mode \[Zucchero Cat Café] will be gradually opened. \[Heroic Mode] will be available for some stages. Commanders can receive generous rewards including \[Collapse Pieces], \[Targeted Access Permissions], and \[Access Permissions] by clearing event stages and participating in the event Game mode.[/p][p]* Available from April 23, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Rate Up Event \[Targeted Procurement] and \[Military Upgrade].[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Helen] and Elite Weapon \[Dulcet Defender] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Sakura] and Elite Weapon \[Crimson Covenant] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Leva] and Elite Weapon \[Schlitzohr] will be increased.[/p][p]■ Added Outfit Procurement - \[Sultry Tempo] in the \[Crew Deck]. Commanders can use the \[Outfit Access Permissions] to perform accesses. Each access has a chance to yield Leva's \[Outfit - Sultry Tempo]  and its swappable orange-quality accessories, Dushevnaya's \[Outfit - Tomorrow‘s Savior] and its swappable purple-quality accessories, new Weapon Skins, new Attachment Skins, new Curios and other items. You can find more details about this event in-game.[/p][p]* During the event \[Antiparallel], Commanders can obtain a total of  \[Outfit Access Permissions*30] by logging into the game, receiving in-game mails, purchasing the "Trendy Outfit Box" in the \[Shop] for free, exchanging it in the \[Furniture Store] of the \[Crew Deck], receiving the reward of "Collect Recreation Point" in the \[Crew Deck] and other methods. [/p][p]* The \[Holography] of the doll "Leva" will be updated in the future, stay tuned. [/p][p]■ Added \[Fitness Center] in the \[Crew Deck]. Commanders can exercise on the \[Multifunctional Treadmill], decorate \[Ornaments] on the \[Fitness Center Display Rack] according to your own preferences, and experience the \[Dulcet Whisper] with Leva on the \[Rowbike].[/p][p]■ Added \[Interludes] in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Blockbusters]. Commanders can review the recorded dialogues of the dolls in \[Interludes] or check the unlocking conditions of the dialogues.[/p][p]■ Added gameplay \[Soirée] in the \[Crew Deck]. Commander can participate in the gameplay in the \[Antiparallel] event interface or go to the \[Crew Deck]. Participating in the gameplay will unlock Helen's exclusive \[Dulcet Whisper] story item and obtain generous rewards.[/p][p]* Helen's exclusive \[Dulcet Whisper] story unlocked through the gameplay \[Soirée - Starlight Gala] is a single-branch storyline and does not have the feature of choosing multiple subplots. The gameplay \[Soirée - Starlight Gala] will remain open in the \[Blockbusters] after the event \[Antiparallel] ends.[/p][p]* Due to the varying playback speeds of text in different languages, Commanders may encounter incomplete display of subtitles when experiencing the story scene. Please adjust it through \[Settings] - \[Others] - \[Story Text Display Speed] to avoid this issue.[/p][p]* Available from April 23, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Covenant and Archive unlocked for \[Helen] and \[Mosin-Nagant]. [/p][p]■ Neural Helix System Expansion: \[Qiuhua].[/p][p]■ Added a new Doll \[Helen] to the \[Holography] in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Added new Dolls \[Helen] and \[Springfield] to the \[Welcome Ceremony] in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Added \[Helen] as a deployable Doll in \[Artifact Recovery - Ashen Tales].[/p][p]■ Added new Boss \[Chimera Centurion] in \[Boss Fight] - \[Crossroad Challenge].[/p][p]* Available from April 27, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New \[Voyage Logs] are available from April 23, 9:00 (UTC-4). Added reward \[Namecard Background - Guardian From Afar] and \[Portrait Frame - Red-Dyed Frost] for \[Broker's Path].[/p][p]■ Added \[Halting Station] in \[Past Events].[/p][p]■ Added Weapon Skins from Past Event in \[Shop] - \[Trading Post] - \[Neural Integration].[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Sign-In Event \[Crafted Cocoon]. During the event, log in for 7 days to receive \[Targeted Access Permission ×10].[/p][p]* Available from April 23, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Event \[Elmo Special Supply]. During the event, log in to receive \[Targeted Access Permission x10] as a reward in event page.[/p][p]* Available from April 23, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Sign-In Event \[Shadowlight Accord]. During the event, Commanders can receive free rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces] and \[Access Permissions] by accumulating a certain number of login days. Commanders can also pay to unlock the "Advanced Support" rewards, which include additional items such as \[Outfit Access Permissions] and \[Targeted Access Permissions].[/p][p]* Available from April 29, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Added Time-Limited Packages \[Bewitching Gift Box - Starlit Waltz], \[Bewitching Outfit Box - Starlight Rondo], \[Flashback Cache Gift Box], \[Primeval Growth Data Pack], \[Savage Growth Data Pack], \[Trendy Outfit Box], \[Starwave Outfit Box], \[Shiny Outfit Box], \[Twofold Revelation Gift Box] and \[Interwoven Radiance Gift Box] in \[Shop] - \[Quality Selection] - \[Time-Limited Package]. Added \[Tomato Base Special Gift Box] Package on a Limited-Time Discount in \[Shop] - \[Outfit Boutique] - \[Curiosity Gallery]. Added new Monthly Gift Pack \[Heartlink Common Key Connection Gift Box] in the \[Shop] - \[Quality Selection] - \[Regular Gift Pack].[/p][p][/p][p][b]- Optimizations & Bug Fixes -[/b][/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Dreamscape] function in the \[Crew Deck], added context preset function, optimized the effect of the Companion Mode, and optimized some interaction logic.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the unlocking status would be displayed abnormally in the \[Common Key Gallery] after dismantling those Common Keys.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the game freezes when Commanders select the Tactical Framework \[Phase Dominion] to explore in \[Artifact Recovery - Ashen Tales] under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the doll does not have lip-sync adaptation in the welcome ceremony of the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where Lewis's \[Outfit - Sunscreen Battle] has abnormal animation display when using the Ultimate on Android devices.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the doll "Suomi" executes abnormally after setting a specific "Fire Control Preset".[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the prompt window pops up abnormally when obtaining the "Targeting Calibration Chip" in \[Boundary Push].[/p][p]■ Fixed certain issues with the texts.[/p]

newsitems.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Update Contents 4/1
newsitems.author: denghaoyuan
newsitems.contents: [p][b]- New Doll -[/b][/p][p]■ Elite Doll \[Lainie][/p][p][/p][p][b]- New Weapons -[/b][/p][p]■ Elite Weapon \[Perihelion][/p][p]■ Standard Weapon \[UMP40][/p][p]■ Retired Weapon \[Retired UMP40][/p][p][/p][p][b]- New Outfit -[/b][/p][p]■ Outfit \[Lainie - Operation Butterfly][/p][p][/p][p][b]- New Contents -[/b][/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event Story \[Breaking Butterfly].[/p][p]・ During the event, new event stories and stages will be gradually opened. \[Heroic Mode] will be available for some stages. Commanders can receive generous rewards including \[Collapse Pieces], \[Targeted Access Permissions], and \[Access Permissions] by clearing event stages and participating in the event Game mode.[/p][p]* Available from April 2, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Rate Up Event \[Targeted Procurement] and \[Military Upgrade].[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Lainie] and Elite Weapon \[Perihelion] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Lewis] and Elite Weapon \[Toysmith] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Klukai] and Elite Weapon \[Skylla] will be increased.[/p][p]■ Covenant and Archive unlocked for \[Lainie] and \[Ksenia].[/p][p]■ Neural Helix System Expansion: \[Lainie] and \[Faye].[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Sign-In Event \[Mirrorborn Metamorphosis]. During the event, log in for 7 days to receive \[Collapse Pieces ×560], \[Mirror Vouchers ×7].[/p][p]* \[Mirror Voucher ×1] can be used to challenge \[Breaking Butterfly - Supply], obtain \[Data Fragments] and exchange for various rewards in the event exchange shop \[Data Consolidation Program]. When the number of \[Mirror Vouchers] you have reaches or exceeds 6, the system will not automatically resupply them on a daily basis. Please make reasonable use of them.[/p][p]Added \[Frozen Prism] feature in the \[Crew Deck]. Commander can take selfies or take group photos with dolls in the \[Crew Deck]. You can freely adjust the Photo Settings, lens effects, Expression and Action Settings, and Filter Settings according to your own preferences. The photos taken can be edited and displayed on the \[Memory Wall].[/p][p]■ Added new Dolls \[Klukai], \[Alva] and \[Leva] to the \[welcome ceremony] in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Added \[Lainie] as a deployable Doll in \[Artifact Recovery - Ashen Tales].[/p][p]■ New \[Voyage Logs] is available from April 2, 9:00 (UTC-4). Added reward \[Namecard Background - Immaculate Soul] and \[Portrait Frame - Autumn Night Osmanthus] for \[Broker's Path].[/p][p]■ Added \[Neural Migration - Into the Shadows] in \[Past Events].[/p][p]■ Added Weapon Skins from past events in \[Shop] - \[Trading Post] - \[Neural Integration].[/p][p]■ Added \[Indicate ability to form Covenant with red dot indicator], \[Red dot notification when no food effects are active] and \[Red dot notification when no drink effects are active] options in \[Settings] - \[Others] - \[Notification Settings].[/p][p]■ Added the exchange of Commander's Outfits and Portrait in the \[Furniture Shop] - \[Sundries].[/p][p]■ Added the collection of Commander's Outfits and count them towards the corresponding "Collection Tokens".[/p][p]■ Added \[Appoint On-Duty Attendant] in the \[Crew Deck]. Commanders can choose specific dolls to participate in the welcome ceremony at Meyling in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Lounge] according to your preferences and set the order of Dolls' appearance. Additionally, a skip function for the welcome ceremony has been added. Commanders can click to skip during the playback of the welcome ceremony performance.[/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event \[Simulation Exercise]. During the event, clear event stages to obtain generous rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces], \[Basic Info Cores], and \[Common Key - Brand New Agreement].[/p][p]* Available from April 8, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]- Optimizations & Bug Fixes -[/b][/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Loop Assistant] function, added the function of adjusting the loop order, added the display of intelligence puzzle consumption for each loop module, added the display of the quantity of owned items in the \[Select battle reward] interface, added the \[Menu File] jump button, and optimized the interaction logic of loop settings.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Refitting Room] - \[View Details] / \[Weapons] / \[Attachments] / \[Key Regulation] / \[Evolve] interfaces. Added the "Doll Recommendation Attribute" indicator in the \[Attribute Details] interface, and added the "Weapons/ Attachments Recommendation Attributes" indicator in the \[Weapon] and \[Attachments] interface, added the "Key Recommendation Attributes" indicator in the \[Key Regulation in] and \[Evolve] interface.[/p][p]■ Optimized the filtering function of \[Attachments], added the \[Equip Status] filter option.[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Commander's Hotline] function in the \[Crew Deck], added the unlockable doll indicator in the \[Private Meeting Logs].[/p][p]■ Optimized the battle performance effect in the stages of \[Artifact Recovery - Ashen Tales].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interface of \[Key Regulation], optimized the description text of the Key instructions.[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Settings] - \[Others] - \[Auto Battle Settings] function, removed the related settings content of \[Military Simulation].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Shop] - \[Outfit Bouquet] interface, added the \[Stylish Outfits] and \[Curiosity Gallery] tabs, added the outfit type filtering and sorting function in the \[Stylish Outfits] interface, and added the new listing indicator in the \[Outfit Bouquet] and \[Custom Skin] interfaces.[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Shop] - \[Furniture Shop] interface, added \[Seasonal Trend] tab.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Common Key Gallery] - \[Events] interface, added the display of the common key collection status and collection quantity in the \[Events].[/p][p]■ Optimized the shortcut key settings of the \[Crew Deck], after this maintenance update, Commanders using PC devices can quickly open the \[Crew Deck Setting] interface by pressing "E" key within the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic and performance effects of the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interface display of the \[Crew Deck] - \[Edit Mode], Commanders can view the Wall Decoration you do not own. At the same time, for the Wall Decoration that are not currently owned and are on sale in the store, they can obtain them through quick purchase.[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Storeroom], Optimized the sorting and switching logic of some items.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Exclusive Procurement] - \[Choose Doll] interface, added the display of the Segment level of the currently owned doll.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Boss Fight] - \[Crossroad Challenge], added the display of the completion status in the \[Stage Information] interface and the Settlement interface.[/p][p]■ Optimized the prompt display of the new content and unlocked content in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Crew Deck Settings] option on mobile devices, added the \[Save picture to system folder] option, after enabling this setting, Commanders using mobile devices can view the photos taken in the system album.[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Attachment Calibration] function, when Commander is calibrating the Attachments, you can hold the item to quickly increase the quantity of the item, or hold the "-" button on the item frame to quickly reduce the quantity of the item.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Combat Exercise] - \[Foe] interface, after optimization, the \[Foe] interface will display the current Portrait frame used by the opponent Commanders.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of Dolls' Portraits in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Crimson Arcade] - \[Elmo Leaderboard].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Dormitory].[/p][p]■ Optimized the voice performance during some dolls battles.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the outfit model of Doll "Klukai" on the mobile device would be displayed abnormally on the \[Crew Deck] under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the Doll couldn't normally apply skills on friendly units when the auto battle was enabled during combat under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the Observation Interface of the Doll on the \[Refitting Room] would be missing the \[Return] button on the mobile device under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the client would have an abnormal problem when entering the \[Refitting Room] - \[Weapons] interface when using the mobile device under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the performance scene would be abnormal when performing \[Delicious Cuisine] on the \[Crew Deck] under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the level 1 skill "Main Dancer's Aura" of the Doll "Yoohee" had an abnormal effect under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the client would have an abnormal problem when viewing \[Stage Information] in the combat stage when using the mobile device under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the pool water performance would be abnormal on the \[Crew Deck] - \[Mirage Terrace] under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the battle opening performance of the enemy boss \[Fused Entropic - Beelneith] would be abnormal when using iOS mobile devices.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the \[Display Wall] editing interface on the \[Crew Deck] would have an abnormal arrangement of the same-sized wall decorations.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the voices of some dolls were abnormal.[/p][p]■ Fixed certain issues with the texts.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Notes:[/p][p]The game will be inaccessible during maintenance. Please plan your time in advance.[/p][p]If you are in a mission when maintenance begins, your progress will not be saved. Please complete your ongoing missions before the maintenance to avoid losing progress.[/p][p]The exact end time of maintenance may be delayed or earlier. Please look to our website or social media accounts for updates in case of any delays.[/p][p]Please claim your maintenance compensation from the mailbox promptly after maintenance ends. Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM Operations Team[/p]

During the event, log in for 7 days to receive \[Targeted Access Permission x10].[/p][p]* Available from February 19, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Event \[Elmo Special Supply]. During the event, log in to receive \[Targeted Access Permission x10] as a reward in event page.[/p][p]* Available from February 19, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Event \[Explosive Machinist]. During the event, by helping the Dolls fulfill their wishes, you can obtain various rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces], \[Basic Info Cores], event-exclusive Decorations, and event-exclusive Souvenirs.[/p][p]* Available from March 1, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Added new area theme \[Lounge Theme: Lodge of Ages], \[Rec Room Theme: Lodge of Ages] and \[Mirage Terrace Theme: Lodge of Ages] in \[Shop] - \[Furniture Shop] - \[Themes].[/p][p]■ Added Time-Limited Packages \[Springtime Snowmelt Gift Box], \[Springtime Splendor Gift Box], \[Flashback Cache Gift Box], \[Primeval Growth Data Pack], \[Savage Growth Data Pack], \[Starry Night Gift Box: Night on the Silver Bay], \[Starry Night Outfit Box - Sparkling Galaxy of Lights], added \[Shining Idol Gift Box] Package on a Limited-Time Discount in \[Shop] - \[Quality Selection] on February, 9:00 (UTC-4).[/p][p][/p][p]GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM Operations Team[/p]

newsitems.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Update Contents 1/8
newsitems.author: wuyuefan
newsitems.contents: [h1]\[Update Contents][/h1][h2]- New Doll -[/h2][p]■ Elite Doll \[Lewis][/p][p]- New Weapons -[/p][p]■ Elite Weapon \[Toysmith][/p][p]■ Standard Weapon \[Lewis Gun][/p][p]■ Retired Weapon \[Retired Lewis Gun][/p][p]- New Outfits & Combat Suit & Skin -[/p][p]■ Outfit \[Lewis - Sunscreen Battle] and its swappable purple-quality accessories[/p][p]■ Themed Weapon Skin Set \[Operation Beachfront][/p][p][/p][h2]- New Contents -[/h2][p]■ Time-Limited Event Story \[Project Neural Convergence]. [/p][p]・ During the event, new event stages and event modes \[Xenomension Abyss] will be gradually opened. \[Heroic Mode] will be available for some stages. Commanders can receive generous rewards including \[Collapse Pieces], \[Targeted Access Permissions], and \[Access Permissions] by clearing event stages and participating in the event Game mode.[/p][p]■ Rate Up Event \[Targeted Procurement] and \[Military Upgrade].[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Lewis] and Elite Weapon \[Toysmith] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Florence] and Elite Weapon \[Iaso] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Peri] and Elite Weapon \[Amanita] will be increased.[/p][p]■ Covenant and Archive unlocked for \[Lewis] and \[Sharkry]. [/p][p]■ Neural Helix System Expansion: \[Peri] and \[Lotta].[/p][p]■ Added a sharing function in the \[Crew Deck]. Commander can share \[Blueprint Code] of their favorite Crew Deck layout plan with their friends or Platoon, or copy the \[Blueprint Code] to the paste board and share it with their friends outside the game. Import the copied \[Blueprint Code] in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Furniture Layout] - \[Preset Management] interface. You can import the corresponding layout plan into your own Crew Deck areas.[/p][p]* Due to the performance limitations of the sharing function, Commanders are unable to share frequently within a short period of time currently. Please use this feature as needed.[/p][p]■ Added \[Weather Notes] function in the \[Crew Deck]. After unlocking the corresponding furniture, the Dolls will leave a message for the Commander based on the weather conditions of your location on that day. Commanders can view the messages left by the Doll through the \[Weather Notes] every day. Meanwhile, the Commander can also set the \[Geolocation] of the \[Crew Deck] in the \[Settings] - \[Others] interface. Enabling \[Geolocation] Settings will help you avoid missing special Dolls' messages.[/p][p]■ Added new stage \[Echelon 11 Part 2] in \[Coordination Drill]. Clear stage to obtain generous rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces] and \[Portrait Frame - Joint Protocol].[/p][p]■ Added \[Escape from Cyborg] in \[Past Events].[/p][p]■ Added new boss \[Tumorhynchus - Massacre] in \[Gunsmoke Frontline].[/p][p]■ Added Weapon Skins from Past Event in \[Shop] - \[Trading Post] - \[Neural Integration].[/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event \[Voyage Logs]. Added reward \[Namecard Background - Return To The Cloud] and \[Portrait Frame - Hunter's Moonrose] for \[Broker's Path].[/p][p]* Available from January 8, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Added \[Loop Assistant] function. The \[Loop Assistant] function can be unlocked when the Commander level reaches 45. After the function is unlocked, Commanders can make relevant Settings in the \[Loop Assistant] and automatically perform operations such as \[Intel Storage], \[Targeted Study], \[Standardizing Sync], \[Cognitive Configuration], \[Equipment Analysis], \[In-Depth Search], \[Neural Survey], \[Combat Exercise], \[Gunsmoke Frontline], and \[Daily Patrol] for reward collection or daily battles. Helps Commanders simplify daily routines.[/p][p]■ Added \[Counter Display Wall] and \[Rec Room Display Wall] in the \[Crew Deck], Commanders can arrange \[Wall Decorations] for wall decoration according to your own preferences.[/p][p]■ Added \[Wall Ornaments] in \[Furniture Shop], Commanders can choose and buy their favorite wall ornaments to decorate the display wall.[/p][p]■ Added some furniture in \[Furniture Shop] - \[Furniture]. Added some ornaments in \[Furniture Shop] - \[Ornaments].[/p][p]■ Added \[Lingering Voices] in \[Elmo Server Room] - \[Traceback]. Commanders can click on past festival days in \[Lingering Voices] and select the doll in the upper left side of the screen to relive the festival blessings.[/p][p]■ Added \[Resource Management] function in \[Settings], and added resource management items of \[Performance in the Refitting Room], \[Voice], \[Story Campaign], \[Past Event], and \[Time-Limited Event]. Commander can choose to delete or download related resources according to your own needs.[/p][p]■ Added \[Resource Settings] - \[Automatically delete] function in \[Settings]. Commanders can choose to enable the function of automatically deleting completed story resources according to your own needs.[/p][p]■ Added Makiatto's exclusive \[Dulcet Whisper] story item \[Time Capsule: Pulse-Racing Night] in \[Shop] - \[Trading Post] - \[Exchange].[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Sign-In Event \[Starry Project]. During the event, logging in cumulatively to the game receives generous rewards such as \[Starry Neural Archive Self-Select Pack], \[Starry Weapon Self-Select Pack], \[Collapse Pieces], and \[Common Key - Critical Singularity].[/p][p]* Commanders can choose one of the following rewards from the \[Starry Neural Archive Self-Select Pack] to obtain: Elite Doll \[Springfield], \[Makiatto], \[Yoohee], \[Vector], \[Mechty], \[Andoris], and \[Evolution Support Box]*1. The \[Evolution Support Box] contains: \[Targeting Calibration Chip ×10], \[Universal Chain Key×400].[/p][p]* Commanders can choose one of the following Elite Weapons from the \[Starry Weapon Self-Select Pack] to obtain: \[Radiance], \[Bittersweet Caramel], \[Sparkling Centerstage], \[Banshee's Whisper], \[Daydream] and \[Aglaea].[/p][p]* Available from January 19, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event \[Simulation Exercise]. During the event, clear event stages to obtain generous rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces], \[Basic Info Cores], and \[Common Key - Looking To Future Strength].[/p][p]* Available from January 14, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event \[Intelligence Supplies]. During the event, log in to the game at the corresponding time to receive \[Intelligence Puzzles] daily.[/p][p]* Available from January 16, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event \[Equipment Analysis - Fission]. During the event, rewards from  \[Equipment Analysis] are increased by 100%.[/p][p]* Available from January 22, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event \[Dangerous Excavation]. During the event, participate in the Event Game Mode to receive generous rewards, including \[Collapse Pieces].[/p][p]* Available from January 24, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Added Time-Limited Packages \[Cruising Gift Box - Sunscreen Battle], \[Cruising Outfit Box - Swimming Pool Carnival] in \[Shop] - \[Quality Selection].[/p][p][/p][h2]- Optimizations & Bug Fixes -[/h2][p]■ Optimized \[Retry] function of \[Gunsmoke Frontline]. A second confirmation screen will be added after Commanders click \[Retry] on the battle settlement interface of \[Gunsmoke Frontline].[/p][p]■ Optimized the "Filtering" function of the \[Refitting Room]. After filtering in the Dolls list, switching interfaces and returning to the \[Refitting Room] interface, the previous filtering results will be retained. After exiting the \[Refitting Room], the filtering results will no longer be retained. At the same time, after filtering the Dolls list, when entering the interfaces of \[Fortification], \[Neural Helix], \[Weapon], and \[Key Regulation] for Dolls and performing the left and right switch operation of Dolls, the displayed Dolls will remain as the previous filtering results.[/p][p]■ Optimized the sharing function of the \[Fire Control Presets]. Commanders can use the sharing code to share their own \[Fire Control Preset] or import others' Presets. At the same time, add the \[Update Fixed Key and Expansion Key changes] function.[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Auto Battle] function. Commanders who have enabled the Auto Battle function in the \[Auto Battle Settings] can decide through a pop-up window whether to turn off the Auto Battle "only this once" or set it to "always close" during the battle when disabling it.[/p][p]■ Optimized the default currency selection logic when purchasing furniture in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Furniture Layout] interface. After the maintenance, \[Merkle Leaf] will be selected as the default currency when purchasing furniture in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Furniture Layout] interface.[/p][p]■ Optimized the information display in the \[Item Details] interface for \[Merkle Leaf], \[Silik], and \[Mood Score], and added the display of acquisition methods.[/p][p]■ Adjusted \[Decoration Gallery] in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Armory] - \[Weapon Rack] / \[Standalone Device Station] interface to "Weapon Index".[/p][p]■ Optimized the display logic of the red dot prompts related to the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized some visual effects in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized some interaction effects in the \[Collectibles].[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Crew Deck] - \[Dreamscape] function. Added a volume adjustment feature, allowing Commanders to adjust the volume while listening to \[Dreamscape] according to their preferences.[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Crew Deck] - \[Display Wall] function. Added an interface zoom feature when editing \[Wall Stickers] and \[Wall Decorations].[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Crew Deck] - \[Delicious Cuisine] / \[Tea Time] related function, and added a notification that buffs did not take effect in the \[Story Campaign] interface and the \[Auto Mode Preparation] pop-up window.[/p][p]■ Optimized the  \[Crew Deck] - \[Build Checklist] interface and added the preview function of xp that can be obtained after unlocking furniture.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display effect of each functional prompt of \[Crew Deck] - \[Map].[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Furniture Shop] interface by adding "New" labels for newly released furniture and ornaments.[/p][p]■ Optimized \[Common Key Gallery] - \[Events] Common Key display, whether Commanders have the corresponding event reward Common Key or not, can be viewed in the \[Common Key Gallery].[/p][p]■ Optimized the description text of the "Boost active" pop-up window for Affinity Key in the \[Formation] - \[Neural Helix] interface.[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Guides] function and added the \[Crew Deck] guide content. Commanders can view the relevant function guidance of the Crew Deck in the \[Guide] - \[Crew Deck] interface.[/p][p]■ Optimized the explanatory text of the functional guide in the \[Guide]- \[Combat Exercise].[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of \[Fire Control Preset] - \[Load Plan] when disabled.[/p][p]■ Optimized the description of Lind's \[Fixed Key - Radio Invitation].[/p][p]* This optimization will not affect the actual effect of the \[Fixed Key - Radio Invitation].[/p][p]■ Optimized \[Item Details] interface for "Universal Key: Skill" and added descriptions related to the Doll to which it belongs.[/p][p]■ Optimized the sorting and filtering logic of the \[Storeroom] - \[Universal Key] - \[Dismantle] interface, and added a secondary confirmation pop-up window for the disassembly of Universal Keys.[/p][p]■ Optimized the redirection logic of story campaign stages in \[Beginner's Assessment].[/p][p]■ Optimized some interaction effects of the \[Wishlist].[/p][p]■ Optimized some interaction logic of the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Guide] function and added relevant explanations for the \[Wishlist][/p][p]■ Optimized the display performance of the buff effects in the \[Gunsmoke Frontline] - \[Frontline Support] interface.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue of abnormal acquisition of \[Portrait - Fluffy Korvatunturi]. Commanders who already have Suomi's \[Outfit - Fluffy Korvatunturi] will be able to obtain the Portrait normally after the maintenance.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the effect of  \[Ullrid]'s Tier II \[Expansion Key - Determined Pursuit] was abnormal.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue of abnormal cumulative progress for \[Title - Skilled Defender], \[Badge - Battle Fanatic], \[Badge - Defender], and \[Badge - The Mysterious Millionaire].[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the Commander model in the \[Crew Deck] displayed abnormally under specific circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed certain issues with the texts.[/p]
